tier: Pay as you go, prepaid credit

free_tier.stated: no free tier; USD 0.90 an hour billed per minute with a one-minute minimum, paid from prepaid credit sold in USD 10 packs that never expires; there is no subscription
free_tier.notes: The landing page gives a five-minute TestFlight session as 7.5 cents. Larger top-ups lower the rate to USD 0.60 an hour, and a 7-day money-back guarantee applies to the first purchase. A job under a minute is billed as one minute.

per_object_cap.stated: not an object-storage offer; 20 GB of encrypted persistent drive is kept per Mac between sessions
per_object_cap.notes: The 20 GB figure is the persistent drive, not a per-file limit.

retention.stated: the Mac and every file outside ~/drive are deleted when the session stops; the encrypted 20 GB drive at ~/drive persists between sessions

egress.terms: not published as a transfer allowance or per-GB price; upload and download links go through *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com and the Mac has internet access

interface_detail: MCP over streamable HTTP at mcp.nomac.app/mcp, an @nomac/cli command-line tool, a REST API, SSH into the running Mac, and a browser desktop to watch or take over the session
tooling: Node 20 or later and OpenSSH for the CLI; an MCP client such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code or ChatGPT; the hosted MCP needs only a sign-in
chaining: an agent opens a disposable Mac over MCP, builds an iOS app with the preinstalled Xcode 27, uploads to TestFlight and stops the machine, with the persistent drive carrying build caches for later runs.

limits.value: USD 0.90 an hour billed per minute, one-minute minimum, prepaid in USD 10 packs; no automatic overage
a session stops after 10 idle minutes or 2 hours by default, and every session has a spending cap
signing in creates the account; prepaid credit must be added before a Mac can start

limits_note: A Mac takes about 30 seconds to become ready. Queue and setup time are free; ready time includes time between commands. A disconnect does not stop billing. App Store submission requires an Apple Developer account, supplied by the user.
binding_note: The per-minute prepaid credit meter and the one-minute minimum are what a short job hits first; the idle and two-hour caps stop longer sessions.

identity_cost.detail: the sign-in page says that signing in creates the account and offers Apple sign-in; the setup guide says to sign in at nomac.app and add credit of USD 10 to USD 1000, with agents able to open a payment link. Credit is prepaid through a payment link, not charged automatically; no phone or ID document is requested on the sign-in page.

reliability_note: Every session uses a fresh Mac that is deleted on stop; a disconnect does not stop billing, so the session must be stopped explicitly or it reaps after 10 idle minutes or 2 hours. Larger top-ups lower the hourly rate and credit never expires.
confidence_note: the landing page, install guide, CLI reference and sign-in page were read on 2026-11-25; the quoted lines establish the price, billing minimum, reaping rules, storage, access paths and signup gate. No account, credit purchase or Mac session was created, so the rung is documented rather than measured.
